set.body: Agents working on a Feature should get the knowledge graph without being asked. When a Feature path or worklog ULID appears in the agent's context, inject a tiny context pack (1 hop, max 8 nodes) so the originating Meeting, Decision and Experiment travel with the work. Gated by pack.auto_inject_on_feature in .pkc/config.yml, which already exists in the config schema but nothing reads yet.
set.title: Agent auto-context injection

set.body: Re-materializing a large worklog rewrites every concept file even when nothing changed, which churns git diffs and makes the operation O(all work) instead of O(changed work). Fingerprint each worklog item so unchanged ULIDs are skipped before any file is touched. The existing 'skipped' return from write_concept already reports this; the win is not reading and re-rendering the file at all.
set.title: Incremental materialize

set.body: Two kinds of project knowledge have no home in the graph today: risks (things that might go wrong, and what mitigates them) and acceptance criteria (the atomic conditions that decide whether a Feature is actually done). Both are first-class OKF concepts with their own typed edges, catalogs and templates.
set.title: Risk and Acceptance concepts

set.body: PKC's capabilities are reachable only from Claude Code and Grok Build because they are packaged as skills. Exposing pack, validate and capture over MCP makes the same knowledge graph available to any MCP host without duplicating the logic.
set.title: MCP server mode

set.body: Recognise when the current work is about a specific Feature: a path under features/ in the conversation, or a worklog item whose materialized concept points at one. Detection only, no injection, so the signal can be tested on its own.
set.title: Detect Feature path or ULID in agent context

set.body: Given a detected Feature, produce the tiny pack (1 hop, max 8 nodes) and place it where the agent will read it. Reuses pkc_pack.py --tiny, which already produces exactly this shape and is asserted in CI.
set.title: Inject tiny pack for the detected Feature

set.body: Auto-injection must be opt-out. Honour pack.auto_inject_on_feature from .pkc/config.yml (already present in config.example.yml and the JSON schema, but nothing reads it yet) and default to off until the behaviour has been used in anger.
set.title: Gate injection behind pack.auto_inject_on_feature

set.body: Compute a stable fingerprint per worklog item from the fields that actually affect the rendered concept: title, body, status, parent, wiki_key. Store it in the concept frontmatter so the next run can compare without re-rendering. content_fingerprint() in pkc_common.py already does the hashing.
set.title: Fingerprint worklog items on materialize

set.body: When an item's fingerprint matches the one recorded in its concept, skip it before reading or rendering the file. Keep reporting skipped counts so the output stays comparable with today's runs.
set.title: Skip unchanged ULIDs without rewriting

set.body: CI already asserts a second materialize run reports '0 created'. Extend it to assert the run also performs zero writes, which is the actual claim incremental materialize is making.
set.title: Assert zero-write re-materialize in CI

set.body: Add a Risk concept type with mitigates and exposes edges, wired through TYPE_TO_DIR, CATALOGS, a template, and the curate hook's catalog list. A Risk links to the Feature or Decision it threatens.
set.title: Add Risk type with mitigates and exposes edges

set.body: Add an Acceptance concept type carrying one atomic, checkable condition, linked to its Feature and to whatever proves it via verified_by. Small nodes on purpose: one criterion each, so they can be checked off independently.
set.title: Add Acceptance type with verified_by edge

set.body: Extend sample-knowledge with a Risk and an Acceptance node on the auth chain so the new types are covered by validate, doctor and the golden pack assertions like every other type.
set.title: Cover Risk and Acceptance in sample-knowledge

set.body: Stand up an MCP server exposing pkc_pack as a tool, resolving the bundle root the same way the CLI does. Pack goes first because it is read-only and the highest-value call for an external agent.
set.title: Expose pack over MCP

set.body: Expose pkc_validate as an MCP tool returning its existing JSON output, so a host can check a bundle without shelling out.
set.title: Expose validate over MCP

set.body: Expose capture over MCP. Write path, so it comes last: it needs the scrub step and the idempotency contract to hold when driven by a host that is not Claude Code.
set.title: Expose capture over MCP

set.body: PKC ships a WikiTicket bridge but did not use it, so the integration was only ever exercised against a four-item test fixture. Scaffold worklog in this repo: bin/, git hooks, .work/ event log, CI invariants. Split the hand-written roadmap into a generated docs/roadmap.md plus a hand-written docs/vision.md for themes and non-goals, and file the v0.5 slice as real work items.
set.title: Adopt WikiTicket SDD in the PKC repo
